normalization: generated resp_, msg_, and rs_ identifiers are normalized by type while every item_id reference is checked
sequence numbers, output indices, content indices, event bodies and terminal response remain exact
covered_cases: reasoning aliases use reasoning_content then reasoning then reasoning_text precedence
leading reasoning closes before the visible assistant message starts
reasoning reported after answer text becomes a distinct later reasoning item
visible answer text and refusal parts retain separate content indices
the assistant message closes before function or custom tool calls
split tool names and arguments are assembled once and validated as JSON objects
usage-only tail chunks preserve token and cache details
literal reasoning/tool markup remains visible text
missing DONE, missing finish reason, duplicate tool IDs and invalid payload shapes fail closed
exactly one completed or incomplete terminal event follows all deltas
side_effects: none; complete response and stream projection are pure
